description: Pinned sources of the per-entity municipal fan-out, which is not tracked in Git. scripts/hydrate-municipal-fanout.py restores each input from its immutable raw copy and verifies it against this pin; the tree digests equal the entries data/release-manifest.v1.json recorded while the files were tracked. Changing an input means publishing a new raw copy (cloudbuild.raw-fanout.yaml) and updating this file in a reviewed commit.

municipal-benchmarks.publication_status: pending: submit cloudbuild.raw-fanout.yaml with _SOURCE_SHA=98abd60e20497611c1993bd884d499cb71d06728 _LOADER_SHA=<main commit carrying the config> _DATASET=municipal-benchmarks _DIRECTORY=data/municipal-benchmarks. The manifest is deterministic for that commit; this SHA-256 is its dry-run value and the hydrator refuses any other.
